description: Test vectors for contract/span-contract-amqp.md (schema version 4, RabbitMQ over AMQP 0-9-1). 'emit': each case is what the application called or the broker sent ('event', in a client-neutral form; 'recorded' lists the deliveries the package had recorded on the channel and not settled). A package must emit exactly the spans in 'spans', in that order: each named 'span_name', whose attributes include exactly 'attributes', carry every name in 'emit_present' (values depend on the process) and none in its 'absent'. Spans of one call share their interval and ticks. 'receive_count' and 'dead_letter' check sections A7 and A8 alone ('headers': the delivery's other headers, if any). A string written {"bytes": "<hex>"} is those bytes on the wire, not valid UTF-8: each package's tests decode it as its client library does (A3). 'ingest': whether a 4.0 Trailbeam accepts a span with these attributes, or the start of the reason it rejects it with (section A12); 'dropped' lists the attributes an accepted span loses (over 255 bytes, A3).
